review: To be precise, I came to this catalog to disprove it. Our worship committee will argue for three hours about a single song and I am usually the one arguing, and I have changed my mind about exactly four albums here, which for me is a significant event. "Olive Root and Grafted Branch" is Romans 11 with the warning left attached, and the Christian Reformed tradition has not always managed that, and I will say so out loud. What I want and cannot get is the theological sourcing — who wrote these lines and what they were reading. That is not a small ask on a committee that argues for three hours.
